name: io.github.notDIRK/fds-mcp
title: FragDenStaat
description: Freedom-of-information requests for Germany via FragDenStaat.de, the froide FOI portal.

environmentVariables.name: FDS_MCP_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Which froide instance to use. Defaults to https://fragdenstaat.de

environmentVariables.name: FDS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth bearer token. Only needed for the tools that read your own requests or submit one; the four search tools work without it.
